title: Haze4K conditional taper-grid measurement qualification
rationale: The completed parent conditional grid route precisely failed only the equal-weight 32-pixel box projection target: mean worst-held-out-grid regret was 0.142335 dB, its one-sided 95 percent interval was [0.125254, 0.159921] dB, and achieved precision was adequate. This orthogonal Stage-1 route changes only grid_definition by replacing equal source-grid weights with a fixed strictly-positive half-sample raised-cosine taper normalized per pixel as a partition of unity. It keeps the same model, data, three hard actions, four grid origins, held-out hard-tile oracle, estimand, 0.10 dB margin, scene bootstrap, controls, and safety gates. The archived box projection is recomputed from the same inference and must reproduce the parent mean regret within 1e-8 dB. Boundary, origin, clipping, and taper-minus-box results are diagnostic only. No terminal authorizes Stage 2.

orthogonal_changes.reason: The parent equal-weight box projection precisely failed. This route changes only the source-utility spatial weighting kernel to a fixed normalized raised-cosine taper while preserving actions, grids, oracle, outcomes, margins, and statistical unit.

scientific_contract.question: On the isolated 100-scene Haze4K development partition, does a fixed source-only raised-cosine taper projection of conditional three-action GT utility have less than 0.10 dB worst-held-out-grid PSNR regret with adequate precision, matched box reproduction, location specificity, non-clipping direction, and SSIM/color safety?

intervention.primary_variable: source-grid tile-mean RGB-MSE utility projected with fixed strictly-positive separable half-sample raised-cosine weights and normalized across the other three grid origins per pixel before held-out-tile averaging
intervention.reference: the same haze condition's held-out-grid GT-selected per-tile oracle over weaken 0.8, keep 1.0, and strengthen 1.2
intervention.matched_budget: one frozen official ConvIR-B inference per each of 400 nested haze conditions followed by deterministic replay of the same three actions; taper and box fields share every inference and utility table
fixed_factors: only the isolated 100-scene development_screening asset is delivered; candidate confirmation and NH-HAZE remain absent
official haze4k-base.pkl SHA-256 6f42037d57a4e3de3a10ac0ab909d66a3415864a19433c29204a975f4efa4088
official ConvIR-B base graph with 8,630,665 frozen parameters and strict checkpoint load
action formula clip(hazy + scale times (official_prediction minus hazy), 0, 1)
hard action set weaken 0.8, keep 1.0, and strengthen 1.2 with exact ties resolved to keep by fixed action order
the four haze variants are substantive observed conditions and are analyzed separately; no utility transfers across variants
grid origins remain exactly (0,0), (0,16), (16,0), and (16,16) pixels with the same valid boundary tiles
each source grid computes the same tile-mean RGB-MSE utility for each action and holds the value constant over its tile
the only changed factor is the source-field projection weight: each tile uses the strictly-positive separable window sin(pi*(i+0.5)/height)^2 times sin(pi*(j+0.5)/width)^2 over its actual support
the three source weights are normalized at each pixel as a partition of unity before averaging projected utility over each held-out tile
no action outputs are blended; the selected held-out-tile action remains one of the same three hard scales
the archived equal-weight box projection is recomputed from the same utility tables and must reproduce parent mean regret 0.1423354325027467 dB within 1e-8 dB
raw per-pixel GT error fields and held-out-grid utility are prohibited from source action selection and taper weights
each grid origin is held out once; its GT tile oracle is used only after both taper and box action fields are frozen
primary scene regret is the maximum held-out-grid taper regret after equal averaging of four conditioned haze variants
negative control circularly shifts only the dense taper action field by 32 pixels on both axes while preserving action frequencies
non-clipping sensitivity selects taper actions and scores taper-minus-uniform PSNR on the same action-common non-clipped pixels
keep scale 1.0 uses structural array identity; duplicate MSE subtraction is diagnostic only against 64 float64 epsilons
RGB MSE defines action utility and PSNR defines primary outcome; whole-image RGB SSIM and absolute channel-bias define safety
20,000 complete-scene bootstrap resamples use fixed seeds 20260801, 20260802, and 20260803
four haze conditions, tiles, pixels, grid origins, metrics, taper and box repeats never increase independent n

primary_estimand.metric: mean canonical-scene maximum-held-out-grid GT-oracle-minus-taper-action PSNR regret after averaging four conditioned haze variants; pass requires one-sided 95 percent scene-bootstrap upper bound below 0.10 dB and upper-bound distance at most 0.05 dB
primary_estimand.aggregation: within each canonical scene and held-out grid average four separately conditioned haze-variant regrets, take the maximum across four held-out grids, then equal-weight complete-scene bootstrap across 100 scenes

controls: strictly positive finite taper weights, exactly three source contributors, nonzero denominator, full image support, and constant-utility invariance are structural gates
the matched box control must reproduce archived parent mean regret within 1e-8 dB from the same inference and utility tables
keep scale 1.0 must reproduce the official prediction by exact structural array identity
weaken and strengthen outputs must equal the declared affine residual transformation on every non-clipped pixel
every shifted source and held-out grid must cover each valid pixel exactly once
the held-out GT per-tile oracle must not have higher RGB MSE than either frozen transferred action field
a 32-pixel circular shift preserves taper action frequencies but breaks registered local alignment
common non-clipped support uses the same action-neutral mask for source selection and scoring
whole-image SSIM and color evaluation prevents invalid additive tile interpretation
hard action agreement, boundary bands, held-out origins, clipping strata, and taper-minus-box change are diagnostic only

uncertainty.method: 20,000-resample complete-scene bootstrap for continuous means and two-sided 95 percent Wilson intervals for material-benefit and harm prevalences; achieved regret upper-bound distance is reported explicitly

gates.estimand: exact parent evidence identities, isolated 100-scene role, 400 finite inferences, taper and box projection structure, matched box reproduction, keep/affine controls, no protected asset, and no training
one-sided 95 percent complete-scene bootstrap upper bound for worst-held-out-grid taper PSNR regret in dB
distance from the primary point estimate to its one-sided 95 percent upper bound in dB
Wilson lower bound for scenes whose minimum-grid taper-minus-GT-best-uniform PSNR is at least 0.10 dB
one-sided 95 percent complete-scene bootstrap lower bound for worst-grid aligned-minus-circularly-shifted taper PSNR in dB
one-sided 95 percent complete-scene bootstrap lower bound for worst-grid common-nonclipped taper-minus-GT-best-uniform PSNR in dB
upper 95 percent Wilson bound for scenes whose worst-grid mean taper-minus-uniform RGB SSIM is at most -0.005
upper 95 percent Wilson bound for scenes whose worst-grid taper-minus-uniform absolute RGB channel-bias is at least 1/255

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: A pass would show only that a fixed translation-reduced source-utility projection qualifies under this synthetic development measurement. A fail with box reproduction would reject simple raised-cosine taper as sufficient and motivate a separately authorized spatial-unit reconstruction; it would not prove local utility absent or continuous actions necessary. Boundary diagnostics can support but not uniquely identify seam aliasing. No result identifies deployment-visible predictability, physical haze mechanisms, real-domain transport, or perceptual optimality.

training, proxy fitting, module construction, representation selection, classifier selection, or threshold adaptation

blending action outputs or creating any continuous effective action scale

using boundary, origin, clipping, hard-agreement, or taper-minus-box diagnostics as an undeclared decision gate

claiming a taper-grid screen pass establishes overall measurement qualification, deployment-time prediction, representation sufficiency, a physical mechanism, perceptual optimality, or real-domain validity
treating haze conditions, grids, tiles, pixels, metrics, taper or box repeats as independent statistical units
automatically entering Stage 2; every terminal must first rerun Stage-1 design qualification

precision_contract.rationale: The directly matched parent conditional-regret scene SD is 0.1060556714 dB. The canonical two-sided-normal planning calculation requires 18 independent scenes for a 0.05 dB half-width, so the frozen n=100 is feasible without counting variants, grids, tiles, pixels, metrics, taper or box repeats.

capability.production_path_statement: The strict-loaded frozen official Haze4K ConvIR-B graph executes on a device-aware 1200 by 1600 no-data fixture, followed by the exact three hard residual actions, four shifted source utility grids, raised-cosine and matched box projection, held-out hard-tile oracle regret, fixed circular-shift control, same-support non-clipped sensitivity, whole-image PSNR/SSIM/color metrics, boundary/origin diagnostics, complete-scene bootstrap, Wilson intervals, and typed terminal finalization.

precision.estimand: mean canonical-scene worst-held-out-grid conditional taper PSNR regret
precision.source_reference: The directly matched archived parent conditional box projection used the same model, data, actions, metric, four origins, grouping, max-grid and mean-variant aggregation and observed canonical-scene regret SD 0.10605567135120934 dB.
